decisions.rule: DytallixHQ/dytallix is dual licensed under the MIT license or the Apache License, Version 2.0, at the user's option (LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE at the root, both texts in each component's LICENSE, SPDX `MIT OR Apache-2.0` in every Cargo manifest). Contributions are licensed the same way. Third-party code keeps its own license, including the Apache-2.0 CometBFT copy.

decisions.question: D14-Q01
decisions.rule: Outside contributions carry a Signed-off-by line from the commit's author under the Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1, and a pull request check refuses commits without one. There is no contributor license agreement. Members' pull requests are not checked.

decisions.question: D14-Q01
decisions.rule: When mainnet/ moves with its history, every commit's personal author and committer address becomes the founder's GitHub noreply address, 24476447+exocognosis@users.noreply.github.com. The personal address is given to the move script on the command line and is never stored in the repository.

decisions.question: D14-Q01
decisions.rule: After the move is pushed and its CI passes, one pull request in exocognosis/dytallix replaces mainnet/ with a README pointing to DytallixHQ/dytallix and removes the mainnet workflows, so there is one live source. Git history keeps the old copy; nothing is permanently deleted.
